exam_scheme.note: Karnataka Common Entrance Test (KCET / UGCET) is an offline OMR entrance examination held over two days in four distinct sessions for Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Biology based on the 1st and 2nd PUC syllabi prescribed by the Department of Pre-University Education of Karnataka State. There is no negative marking.

papers.negative_marking: None (no negative evaluation for incorrect answers)

papers.negative_marking: None (no negative evaluation for incorrect answers)

papers.negative_marking: None (no negative evaluation for incorrect answers)
